note: Wording: ENCIG 2023 Cuestionario general (INEGI), Seccion V (Evaluacion de servicios publicos bajo demanda), question 5.3 (public education in universities or technological universities; stem -> section_prompt of section _1; options 1-8 -> item_text) and 5.3a (section _2, satisfaction, Tarjeta B lado A codes 1-6). All 18 distinct shipped Spanish strings are exact substrings of the whitespace-normalised pdftotext -raw text of the 2023 PDF (18/18), and were checked against the rendered page-8 image. Kept as printed: the fill (ESTADO) and the stem's trailing '...'. Stripped: question/option numbers, dot leaders, interviewer directions (REGISTRA EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; CUANDO EN TODAS LAS OPCIONES SE REGISTRE CODIGO 9, NO APLIQUES LA PREGUNTA 5.3a Y PARA CONTINUAR VERIFICA LA RESPUESTA DE LA PREGUNTA 5.1; MUESTRA LA TARJETA 'B / LADO A'; CIRCULA UN SOLO CODIGO); line wraps joined with a space. 'No sabe / no responde' (code 9) has no row because the .py sets 9 missing (e.g. 2023 P5_3_1 has 42 code-9 answers, 2021 P5_3_1 296). instructions blank: the section-V read-aloud C3 is not carried, as in the sibling tables. 5.3b (grade 0-10) is not in this table. Codes: data/mexico_2023_quality.py (#2415 rebuild) lowercases INEGI column names and melts p5_3_1..8, p5_3a (item IS the INEGI column name, core model s3 pattern 1); the questionnaire numbers 5.3's options 1-8, so code<->text is the instrument's own numbering (the INEGI zip carries no data dictionary, hence paper_explicit, not data_labels). Step 3b / 2021 rows: the table stacks ENCIG 2021 (cov_year=2021, ids 38967..78896; 2023 ids 1..38966). Section V WAS renumbered in 2023 (5.7 IMSS-Bienestar and 5.11 Cablebus inserted; 5.1 options also renumbered), but 5.3 is 5.3 in both editions: RENAME_2021 has no p5_3* entry and ASKED_2021 keeps same-named P5_3_1..8, P5_3A -- confirmed by counts (each 2021 vector matches only its namesake among 99 section-V columns) and by routing (2021 5.3 answerers = exactly the 2582 P5_1_2 = Si respondents, the university option of the 2021 screener; 2023: 2730 = P5_1_02 Si). 2021 wording: stem reads 'Durante 2021'; items 1-4 and the 5.3a question are word-identical; items 5-8 are ungendered ('maestros' for 'maestros(as)', 'el alumno ... pocos estudiantes', 'los egresados sean aptos') and the satisfaction labels are ungendered (Muy satisfecho ... Muy insatisfecho). Options 1-8 of 5.3 are word-identical to options 2-9 of 5.2 (schooling), so the text alone does not distinguish the blocks; the count match against all section-V columns and the routing check do. No instrument mismatch: the live items are this question; the dictionary Description 'University Service Quality' is accurate. Resp: the .py recodes 1 (Si) -> 0, 2 (No) -> 1 and sets 9/98/99 missing, so resp 0 = Si, 1 = No; P5_3A kept 1..6; both yes/no levels and all six satisfaction levels used in both waves, so every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Verified (verify_mexico_2023_quality_university.R, PASS): route 9 per wave 9/9 (2023) and 9/9 (2021) item vectors reproduce INEGI microdata cell for cell, each matching exactly one of all section-V rating columns of its wave (122 in 2023, 99 in 2021), its namesake; routing check ties the P5_3 block to 5.1 option 02 in both waves. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire; item translations reuse the batch_427 schooling renderings for the shared wording. Sheet1 STOP overridden, Ben to confirm: table_context.R printed STOP (Sheet1 links a hand-built per-table sheet 11oOE0mriKvT5F1lr7H4wDRaDOCqkV8EtelKMsdAdQGY); proceeded because the orchestrator queued it under #2381, the table is not in live_tables.csv (never uploaded), and that sheet fails the gate as-is (resp 1/2/'null' vs live 0/1; option numbers '1 '..'8 ' prefixed into item_text and item_text_translated; trailing '?.' on items 2, 5, 6; stem missing its opening '¿'; 'confia' missing its accent; instrument field is the dictionary Description 'University Service Quality'; 5.3a question duplicated as both section_prompt and item_text) -- same shape as the batch_424-428 precedents.
